# Elijah Adeyeye - Profile Overview

Elijah Adeyeye is an AI, behavioural and cybersecurity researcher and the founder and CEO of Elitech Hub. His research covers the intersection of artificial intelligence, human behaviour, security, and high-stakes decision-making.

## Key Projects & Tools
- **NumIntel**: A phone number intelligence tool for validating, formatting and understanding phone numbers across international numbering systems. https://elijahadeyeye.vercel.app/numintel
- **Elitech Hub**: A cybersecurity and digital skills training hub. https://www.elitechub.com
